# Adhbhut Gyaan

> Authentic Vedic pooja and astrology services from Kashi (Varanasi), by Pt. Dr. Umang Nath Sharma - a Kashi Vedic family tradition of 400+ years. Poojas can be booked online (live video, with your own Sankalp) or in person at Kashi.

## Services
- [Astrology Consultation](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/astrology-consultation): Comprehensive birth-chart analysis, planetary-affliction remedies, and authoritative astrological guidance for life's every concern, by Dr. Umang Nath Sharma.
- [Vipreet Pratyangira Paath](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/vipreet-pratyangira): The most potent tantric rite for protection against black magic and hostile sorcery, returning negative energy to its origin.
- [Dus Mahavidya Paath](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/mahavidya-paath): A profound tantric invocation dedicated to the ten Mahavidyas, for the removal of adversarial obstacles and the fulfilment of heartfelt aspirations.
- [Tripindi Shradh (Pitru Pooja)](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/tripindi-shradh): A sacred Shraddha rite performed at Kashi's Pishach Mochan Tirtha to dispel Pitru Dosha and grant eternal peace to unfulfilled ancestral souls.
- [Kalsarp Dosh Nivaran](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/kalsarp-dosh): A duly ordained ritual at the sacred Naga Koop temple, for deliverance from the inauspicious influence of Rahu-Ketu, life’s persistent obstacles, and troubling dreams.
- [Rudrabhishek](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/rudrabhishek): The most sacred abhishekam of Lord Shiva - invoked for the alleviation of illness, the fulfilment of cherished wishes, and the dissolution of accumulated sin.
- [Kanakdhara Stotra Paath](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/kanakdhara-stotra): The glorious hymn composed by Adi Shankaracharya himself, chanted for the alleviation of dire poverty and the bestowal of sudden, unexpected prosperity.
- [Ganesh Atharvashirsha](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/ganesh-atharvashirsha): Invoked to dissolve obstacles in auspicious undertakings, sharpen intellect and concentration, and bestow success in commerce and enterprise.
- [Shree Suktam Paath](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/shree-suktam): The most sacred hymn of the Rigveda, chanted to invoke Goddess Lakshmi's special grace, abundant prosperity, and a flourishing enterprise.
- [Purush Suktam Paath](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/purush-suktam): A Vedic hymn consecrated to Lord Vishnu, chanted for robust health, longevity, the pacification of Pitru Dosha, and the dissolution of sin.
- [Kumbh Vivah (Manglik Dosh)](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/kumbh-vivah): A symbolic pre-marital wedding rite performed to pacify the inauspicious effects of Manglik Dosha before the actual nuptials.
- [Griha Pravesh & Vastu Shanti Pujan](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/griha-pravesh): Scripturally-grounded Vastu-defect pacification and prosperity ritual before entering a new home.
- [Navgrah Shanti & Rudrabhishek](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/navgrah-shanti): A special Havan and Rudrabhishek ritual to pacify the inauspicious influence of all nine planets.
- [Mahamrityunjaya Jaap Anushthan](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/services/mahamrityunjaya-jaap): The supremely powerful Mahamrityunjaya mantra Jaap for health, longevity, and protection from untimely death.

## Free tools
- [Daily Panchang](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/panchang): tithi, nakshatra, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit Muhurat and Choghadiya for any city
- [Daily and monthly Horoscope](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/horoscope): for all 12 rashis, from live planetary transits
- [Free Vedic Kundli](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/free-kundli): Lagna, Chandra and Surya Kundali with planetary positions (Lahiri ayanamsa)
- [Shubh Muhurat](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/muhurat): marriage, griha pravesh, naamkaran and business launch dates
- [Vastu Score](https://www.adhbhutgyaan.com/vastu-score): basic Vastu analysis of a home
